meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随时查阅界面风格、配色、字体与动效规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计网页或应用界面，想快速找到合适的风格与规范。
copy.tagline_en: Look up UI styles, palettes, fonts, and motion presets on demand.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build websites or apps and need quick design guidance.

howto.what: 装上后，处理 UI 设计、构建或审查任务时，Claude 会查询内置设计数据库（风格、配色、字体、UX指南等），按优先级给出建议。新页面先生成整套设计系统，可再查询图标、动效、图表，并能保存设计系统供后续沿用。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 UI 结构、视觉设计、交互模式或体验审查时触发，例如设计新页面、选择配色/字体/布局、审查可访问性与一致性等。纯后端、API、基础设施等非视觉任务不触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个美妆水疗网站的首页，并给出配色和字体方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成整套设计系统建议。

say.text: 审查这个登录页的UX，重点看可访问性和表单反馈。
say.note: Claude 会按优先级检查对比度、错误提示等。

say.text: 用 SwiftUI 给这个应用配一套图标和触控反馈动效。
say.note: Claude 会查询图标条目和动效预设给出代码。

howto.what_en: After install, for UI design/build/review tasks, Claude queries a local design database (styles, palettes, fonts, UX guidelines, etc.) and gives prioritized recommendations. For new pages it generates a design system, can search icons/motion/charts, and can save the system as project files.
howto.when_en: Triggers on UI structure, visual design, interaction, or UX review tasks—e.g., designing new pages, choosing colors/typography/layout, checking accessibility. Not for pure backend, API, or infrastructure tasks.

say_en.text: Design a homepage for a beauty spa website with a color palette and font pairing.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full design system recommendation.

say_en.text: Review this login page's UX, focusing on accessibility and form feedback.
say_en.note: Claude checks contrast, error hints, etc., by priority.

say_en.text: Create icons and touch-feedback motion for this app in SwiftUI.
say_en.note: Claude queries icon entries and motion presets for code.
